notes: Source audited = Introduced-in-House (IH) text; bill has since passed the House by voice vote (2026-07-20, engrossed version exists) but only the IH text was available as source, so all operative provisions were judged against the introduced text. Ref source usc-31-6101.txt supplies the FFATA note (Federal award definition, public searchable website). No material discrepancies. Minor rows: extrinsic OTA=DoD/innovation characterization (summary/brief/likelihoodReason), "CFO Act agencies" gloss over the verbatim 31 U.S.C. 901(b)(1)-(2) citation, FAR clause rendered 52.204-10 vs source 52.204.10, "agency financial report" gloss over the 3521(f)/9105(a)(3) report, and "3 cosponsors" vs 2 named in the introduced text.
